26294.meaning2: caused to move or practise, circulated

examples.text: gopālako sāyanhasamaye sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātetvā iti paṭisañcikkhati, ajja kho gāvo amukasmiñ'ca amukasmiñ'ca padese cariṃsu

26296.commentary: (THIa) pure carin'ti pubbe nigaṇṭhī hutvā evaṃ vicariṃ.

examples.text: lūnakesī paṅkadharī, ekasāṭī pure cariṃ, avajje vajjamatinī, vajje c'āvajjadassinī.
atha kho, bhikkhave, lāpo sakuṇo sakuṇagghiyā hariyamāno evaṃ paridevasi, mayam'ev'amha alakkhikā, mayaṃ appapuññā, ye mayaṃ agocare carimha paravisaye.
yo dhammaṃ cari kāyena, vācāya uda cetasā, idh'eva naṃ pasaṃsanti, pecca sagge pamodatī'ti.
na, bhikkhave, tathāgato idān'eva lokassa atthaṃ carati, pubbe'pi cari'y'evā'ti
sace c'assa kathākāmo, kālam'aññāya paṇḍito, dhammaṭṭhapaṭisaṃyuttā, yā ariyacaritā kathā.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… candaggāhaṃ sūriyaggāhaṃ sukkarāhucaritaṃ uḷuggahayuddhaṃ devadundubhissaraṃ okkanti ukkāpātaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā
